manifest.name: Shopping list
manifest.description: Shared shopping list: quick add, quantities, aisles, tap to check off in the store, bought items come back next time.
widget.list.name: Shopping list
widget.list.description: Open items with big checkboxes and a quick-add field.
page.shopping.name: Shopping
list.newHint: the list appears once you add something to it.
list.tidyHint: remove bought items older than {days} days (until then they stay in the suggestions)
tip.text: sets quantity and aisle. type @ for the aisle templates; most items find their aisle on their own, and things you bought before come back from the suggestions with their aisle.
picker.title: aisle for {name}
bought.title: bought recently
bought.hint: tap to put it back on the list.
